svg.title: OpenID Connect (OIDC)
svg.desc: OpenID Connect (OIDC). An ID token on top of OAuth 2.0 tells the app who signed in. Step 1, Sign in to Shop: Shop sends Ana to the provider with scope openid and a nonce. She signs in; an SSO session starts. Step 2, Validate the ID token: Shop checks the ID token's signature (JWKS), iss, aud, exp and nonce, then starts a session for sub. Step 3, Single sign-on: Support redirects to the provider. Its SSO session means no password; Support gets its own ID token. Step 4, ID token vs access token: The ID token stays in Shop. APIs take the access token; an API that checks aud rejects an ID token.

g.text: Shop sends Ana to the provider with scope openid and a nonce. She signs in; an SSO session starts.
Shop checks the ID token's signature (JWKS), iss, aud, exp and nonce, then starts a session for sub.
Support redirects to the provider. Its SSO session means no password; Support gets its own ID token.
The ID token stays in Shop. APIs take the access token; an API that checks aud rejects an ID token.
